en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large war memorial in a landscaped square or park. The monument consists of a tall obelisk topped by a sculpture of an eagle with spread wings. At the base are dramatic bronze figures of soldiers, including a wounded or fallen one, and decorative elements such as lion heads with chains. Surrounding the monument are trimmed hedges, low posts, and buildings in the background. At the top of the card is printed German text: "Brüx. Kriegerdenkmal."
